```{python}
# =================
# Imports and Setup
# =================

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.manifold import TSNE

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import gmean

from skbio.stats.distance import DistanceMatrix, permanova
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform
from skbio.stats.distance import permdisp

aa_columns = ["Ala","Arg","Asn","Asp","Cys","Gln","Glu","Gly","His","Ile",
    "Leu","Lys","Met","Phe","Pro","Ser","Thr","Trp","Tyr","Val"]
pct_columns = [aa + "_pct" for aa in aa_columns]

samples = pd.read_parquet("hugerth_sample_profiles.parquet")
```


```{python}
# =======================
# Merge metadata and CSTs
# =======================

meta = pd.read_csv("meta_data.csv", encoding="utf-8-sig")
meta_sub = meta[["Run", "Subject", "Visit_No."]].rename(columns={"Run": "sample_id"})
samples = samples.merge(meta_sub, on="sample_id", how="left")

cst = pd.read_pickle("ravel_csts.df").reset_index().rename(columns={"Sample": "sample_id"})
samples = samples.merge(cst[["sample_id", "CST"]], on="sample_id", how="left")

samples = samples.dropna(subset=["CST"]).copy()
samples["CST"] = samples["CST"].astype(int)

print(samples.shape)
print(samples["CST"].value_counts().sort_index())
```

```{python}
X = samples[pct_columns].values
P = np.where(X == 0, X[X > 0].min()/2, X)
X_clr = np.log(P/gmean(P, axis=1, keepdims=True))
```

```{python}
# ===================
# CDS Count Histogram
# ===================

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.hist(samples["n_cds"], bins=40, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_title("CDS Counts by Sample")
ax.set_xlabel("CDS count")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Samples")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ===========================
# Amino Acid Count Histograms
# ===========================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(10, 2, figsize=(12, 24))
axes = axes.flatten()

for ax, aa, pct_col in zip(axes, aa_columns, pct_columns):
    ax.hist(samples[pct_col], bins=40, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3)
    ax.set_title(aa)
    ax.set_xlabel("AA composition (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Number of samples")

fig.suptitle("AA Profiles by Sample", fontsize=16, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# =====================
# GC vs. AA composition
# =====================

cst_levels = sorted(samples["CST"].unique())
cmap_cst = plt.get_cmap("tab10")
cst_colors = {c: cmap_cst(i) for i, c in enumerate(cst_levels)}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(10, 2, figsize=(12, 24))
axes = axes.flatten()
for ax, aa, pct_col in zip(axes, aa_columns, pct_columns):
    for c in cst_levels:
        m = samples["CST"] == c
        ax.scatter(samples.loc[m, "GC_content"], samples.loc[m, pct_col],
                   color=cst_colors[c], alpha=0.5, s=12, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(aa)
    ax.set_xlabel("GC content (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("AA composition (%)")

handles = [plt.Line2D([0],[0], marker="o", color="w",
           markerfacecolor=cst_colors[c], markersize=6, label=f"CST {c}")
           for c in cst_levels]
fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower center", ncol=len(cst_levels), fontsize=9,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.01))
fig.suptitle("GC Content vs. Amino Acid Profile by CST", fontsize=16, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ======================
# PCA color coded by CST
# ======================

pca = PCA()
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_clr)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for c in cst_levels:
    m = samples["CST"] == c
    ax.scatter(X_pca[m, 0], X_pca[m, 1], color=cst_colors[c],
               alpha=0.6, s=14, linewidths=0, label=f"CST {c}")
ax.set_title("PCA of AA Profiles by CST")
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:.1%})")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({pca.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:.1%})")
ax.legend(title="CST", markerscale=1.5, fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ==============
# PCA Scree Plot
# ==============

evr = pca.explained_variance_ratio_
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

axes[0].bar(range(1, len(evr)+1), 100*evr)
axes[0].set_title("Scree Plot")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Principal component")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Variance explained (%)")

axes[1].plot(range(1, len(evr)+1), 100*evr.cumsum(), marker="o")
axes[1].axhline(90, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, color="gray")
axes[1].set_title("Cumulative Variance Explained")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Number of components")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Cumulative variance (%)")
axes[1].set_ylim(0, 105)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ================
# PCA Loading Plot
# ================

load = pca.components_[:2].T

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
ax.scatter(load[:,0], load[:,1], alpha=0.7, s=30, linewidths=0)
for i, aa in enumerate(aa_columns):
    ax.annotate(aa, (load[i,0], load[i,1]), fontsize=9,
                xytext=(3, 3), textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_title("PCA Loadings")
ax.set_xlabel("PC1 Loading")
ax.set_ylabel("PC2 Loading")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ==========
# PCA Biplot
# ==========

span = max(abs(X_pca[:,0]).max(), abs(X_pca[:,1]).max())
scale = 0.7*span/abs(load).max()
hw = 0.02*span

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7))
for c in cst_levels:
    m = samples["CST"] == c
    ax.scatter(X_pca[m,0], X_pca[m,1], color=cst_colors[c],
               alpha=0.6, s=14, linewidths=0, label=f"CST {c}")
for i, aa in enumerate(aa_columns):
    ax.arrow(0, 0, load[i,0]*scale, load[i,1]*scale,
             linewidth=0.7, color="black", head_width=hw)
    ax.annotate(aa, (load[i,0]*scale, load[i,1]*scale), fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("PCA Biplot by CST")
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({evr[0]:.1%})")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({evr[1]:.1%})")
ax.legend(title="CST", markerscale=1.5, fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
print(samples.groupby("CST")[["GC_content","Cys_pct","n_cds"]].mean())
```

```{python}
# ========================
# t-SNE color coded by CST
# ========================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
axes = axes.flatten()

for ax, perp in zip(axes, [15, 30, 45, 60]):
    tsne = TSNE(n_components=2, random_state=42, perplexity=perp)
    X_tsne = tsne.fit_transform(X_clr)
    for c in cst_levels:
        m = (samples["CST"] == c).values
        ax.scatter(X_tsne[m, 0], X_tsne[m, 1], color=cst_colors[c],
                   alpha=0.6, s=14, linewidths=0, label=f"CST {c}")
    ax.set_title(f"perplexity={perp}")

handles = [plt.Line2D([0],[0], marker="o", color="w",
           markerfacecolor=cst_colors[c], markersize=6, label=f"CST {c}")
           for c in cst_levels]
fig.legend(handles=handles, title="CST", loc="center right", fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle("t-SNE of AA Profiles by CST", fontsize=14)
fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.88, top=0.93, hspace=0.25, wspace=0.2)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# =========
# PERMANOVA
# =========

D = squareform(pdist(X_clr, metric="euclidean"))
dm = DistanceMatrix(D, ids=samples["sample_id"].astype(str).values)

res = permanova(dm, samples["CST"].astype(str).values, permutations=999)
print(res)


# ========
# PERMDISP
# ========

res_disp = permdisp(dm, samples["CST"].astype(str).values, permutations=999)
print(res_disp)
```
